services.name: Family Camp Out
services.desc: Whether you're new to camping or want it to be set up for you, Adventure Hill is the place to be! We will provide 4 and 6 person tents, water, firewood, and access to bathrooms. The $30 registration cost includes one 4 or 6 person tent. There will be options to add additional tents if needed. The cost per person includes the cost for smores and a light continental breakfast on Sunday All Ages

services.name: Aerial Yoga
services.desc: Take your yoga practice to the air literally with OUTDOOR Aerial Yoga! This specialty and unique style of yoga uses a hammock to strengthen, support and suspend your body. Open up energy lines and loosen fascia and connective tissue, while having FUN! The hammock is used as a tool to rock and soothe sore and tight muscles and minds. Expect to release tension on your bones and muscles, increasing flexibility and strength. This is an introduction to Aerial Yoga and suitable for all levels. Learn how to use the hammock as a prop, explore various basic inversions, and a sample of restorative For ages 8+

services.name: Pool SUP Yoga
services.desc: Experience mindfulness mixed with challenge and adventure as you take your practice from land to water! Held by anchors in a pool, you'll be led through a series of yoga postures designed for a paddleboard. From basic to advanced, have FUN exploring your edges and maybe falling into the water trying! Beginners at yoga and SUP are welcome! Sundays 9- 10 am (Please arrive by 8:45 am) June 8, 22 July 13, 27 August 3, 17, 31 Fee: $42 Members/ $48 Non-Members What to Bring: wear a bathing suit or something you feel comfortable getting wet, water bottle and towel. services.desc: Our Adaptive 1-on-1 Program at Bretton Woods Recreation Center is dedicated to providing personalized outdoor experiences for children and teens of all abilities and needs. This program pairs each participant with a trained adventure guide who offers individualized attention and support throughout a variety of outdoor activities, ensuring safety, accessibility, and fun. Participants can explore a wide range of adaptive adventures, including kayaking, hiking, ropes courses, and wilderness exploration, all tailored to their unique abilities and comfort levels. services.name: Aerial Ropes (Wood Zip Line & Balance Beam)
services.desc: Challenge your balance and soar through the trees with Bretton Woods’ Balance Beam and Wood Zip Line! Our Balance Beam course features a series of sturdy wooden beams suspended above the ground, designed to test your focus, coordination, and agility in a safe, natural setting. It’s a fun and engaging way to improve balance while enjoying the outdoors. For those seeking an adrenaline rush, the Wood Zip Line offers an exciting glide through the forest canopy. Experience the thrill of flight as you zip from platform to platform, taking in scenic views and the fresh air beneath you. Both Ages 5+ • 3 Hours • Participants must be a minimum of 30lbs

services.name: Archery and Zip Line (Valley)
services.desc: Discover adventure and excitement at Bretton Woods with our Archery and Valley Zip Line experiences! Archery offers a perfect blend of focus, skill, and fun. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced archer, enjoy shooting arrows in a safe, supportive environment with expert guidance. It’s great for individuals, families, and groups looking to learn or hone their skills. Then, take your adventure to new heights with the Valley Zip Line—a thrilling ride soaring above the scenic valley below. Feel the rush as you glide through the valley, surrounded by nature’s beauty. Led by trained staff, Ages 5+ • 3 Hours • Participants must be a minimum of 30lbs

Enjoy the great outdoors while learning a timeless sport that sharpens concentration and coordination. Perfect for casual fun, birthday parties, team-building, or just trying something new! Our certified instructors work closely with you to improve your technique, accuracy, and confidence in a safe and supportive environment. services.name: Camp Out at Adventure Hill
services.desc: Experience the thrill of an overnight adventure at Bretton Woods by camping out on scenic Adventure Hill. This program offers children, teens, and families the chance to spend a night under the stars surrounded by nature’s beauty. Nestled atop Adventure Hill, the campsite provides stunning views and a peaceful woodland setting perfect for enjoying campfire traditions like storytelling and roasting marshmallows. services.name: Camp Out At the Wilderness Camp
services.desc: Escape into nature with an unforgettable overnight experience at Bretton Woods’ Wilderness Camp Site. Perfect for campers seeking a true outdoor adventure, this program offers a chance to spend a night immersed in the serene beauty of the wilderness. Set amidst towering trees and natural surroundings, the Wilderness Camp Site provides an authentic camping atmosphere where participants can enjoy classic camping activities such as campfire storytelling, cooking over an open flame, and stargazing beneath a vast night sky. During the day, campers have access to nearby hiking trails and nature Ages 5+ • 20 Hours

services.name: Canoeing: Poole’s Store to Riley’s Lock
services.desc: Experience a peaceful and scenic canoe trip along the Seneca Creek with Bretton Woods’ guided canoeing adventure from Pooles Store to Riley’s Lock. This journey offers paddlers of all skill levels the chance to glide through calm waters while taking in the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape. The route features lush greenery, wildlife sightings, and historic landmarks, making it a perfect outing for families, friends, or solo adventurers looking to connect with nature. Along the way, you’ll enjoy the tranquility of the canal, learn about the area’s history, and appreciate the gentle Ages 5+ • 3 Hours • Participants must be a minimum of 30lbs

services.name: Cooking and Nature Crafts
services.desc: Discover the joys of outdoor living with Bretton Woods’ Campfire Cooking and Nature Crafts program! This hands-on experience invites participants to learn basic campfire cooking techniques, preparing delicious meals and snacks over an open flame. Alongside cooking, campers engage in creative nature crafts using materials gathered from the surrounding environment—making unique keepsakes like pine cone art, leaf prints, and natural jewelry. This blend of practical skills and artistic expression encourages a deeper connection with nature. Perfect for families, youth groups, and outdoor All Ages • 3 Hours

services.name: CPR and First Aid Training
services.desc: Be prepared to respond confidently in emergencies with Bretton Woods’ CPR and First Aid Training courses. Designed for individuals, families, and professionals, these comprehensive classes teach essential life-saving skills, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), choking relief, wound care, and basic first aid techniques. Led by certified instructors, the training combines hands-on practice with expert guidance to ensure participants gain the knowledge and confidence needed to handle a variety of emergency situations.
